results.name: final_loopback_evm
results.notes: evm_db: composite TX+RX loopback EVM (shared LO — phase noise cancels); tx_evm_db: PA-output EVM at the 802.11be TX spec measurement point; rx_evm_db: ideal waveform into the RX at the loopback's coupled level (independent LO). Each in two views: *_evm_db is the isolation view (per-tone EQ vs the ideal reference + genie CPE, the replay's closure target); *_evm_modem_db is the modem form (LTF CFO acquisition + LTF channel estimate smoothed over 9 tones + pilot CPE, the spec verdict's input); profile=factory

tx_lpf_corner.fc_hz.meaning: TX baseband corner as tuned (target 1.3 x BW/2, the DPD bandwidth)
tx_lpf_corner.fc_hz.better: n/a — a design target, not a defect
tx_lpf_corner.fc_hz.apply: 5th-order Butterworth magnitude response at this corner on the transmit side. A per-tone-equalized receiver removes it entirely; carry it only for unequalized consumers or absolute-power work.

tx_lpf_corner.fc_err_pct.meaning: corner tuning error relative to its target
tx_lpf_corner.fc_err_pct.apply: do not inject — the achieved corner fc_hz already contains this error.

rx_lpf_corner.fc_hz.meaning: RX channel-select corner as tuned (target 1.12 x BW/2)
rx_lpf_corner.fc_hz.better: n/a — a design target, not a defect
rx_lpf_corner.fc_hz.apply: 5th-order Butterworth magnitude response at this corner on the receive side, before the equalizer. Same per-tone-EQ caveat as the TX corner.

rx_lpf_corner.fc_err_pct.meaning: corner tuning error relative to its target
rx_lpf_corner.fc_err_pct.apply: do not inject — fc_hz already contains it.

rx_dc_offset.worst_dc_dbfs.meaning: residual DC at the ADC input after analog coarse + digital fine correction, worst across the 8 AGC states
rx_dc_offset.worst_dc_dbfs.apply: add a complex constant at (worst_dc_dbfs + adc_backoff_db) dB relative to signal power — the conversion from full-scale-relative to signal-relative needs the conditions block's adc_backoff_db. The constant lands on subcarrier zero, which 802.11be leaves unmodulated, so data-tone EVM is structurally almost blind to it; it prices receiver dynamic range, not constellation error.

rx_dc_offset.worst_dc_dbfs_after_analog.meaning: residual DC after the analog coarse stage alone, worst state — the headroom the digital fine stage works inside
rx_dc_offset.worst_dc_dbfs_after_analog.apply: do not inject — superseded by worst_dc_dbfs, which is the shipped end state.

tx_lo_leak_envdet.lo_leak_dbc.meaning: TX carrier leakage at the PA output relative to signal power, measured by the envelope detector
tx_lo_leak_envdet.lo_leak_dbc.apply: add the complex constant c with |c|^2 = 10^(dBc/10) x signal power, before the channel. Same DC-bin caveat as the RX DC: near-zero for 11be data-tone EVM, real for the spectral mask. Duplicate of the loopback measurement — apply at most one of the pair.

tx_lo_leak_loopback.lo_leak_dbc.meaning: TX carrier leakage at the PA output relative to signal power, measured through the loopback receiver (the finer of the two instruments)
tx_lo_leak_loopback.lo_leak_dbc.apply: same recipe as the envelope-detector entry; this is the one to keep when applying.

rx_iip2.iip2_dbm.meaning: receive IIP2 after trim (mixer even-order null)
rx_iip2.iip2_dbm.apply: matters only with a blocker present: the IM2 pseudo-baseband product sits at P_IM2 = 2 x P_blocker - IIP2 (all dBm at the same reference plane). Without a blocker there is nothing to inject — a clean-channel EVM replay must list this key as not consumed, with this reason.

loopback_delay.delay_ns.meaning: measured loopback path delay, used to align calibration captures
loopback_delay.delay_ns.better: n/a — a property of the test path, not of the part
loopback_delay.delay_ns.apply: do not inject — instrument alignment, already compensated inside every measurement in this file.

tx_iq.irr_min_db.meaning: TX image rejection after the frequency-dependent correction, worst tone across the occupied band
tx_iq.irr_min_db.apply: inject the widely-linear response y = u + g*conj(u) with |g| = 10^(-irr_min_db/20), before the channel. The residual is frequency dependent and this is its worst point, so a flat figure is conservative.

group_delay.estimated_ps.meaning: the I/Q rail group-delay mismatch the estimator measured and the wideband w2 FIR absorbed
group_delay.estimated_ps.better: n/a — an estimate of the part, not a defect left in
group_delay.estimated_ps.apply: do not inject — the w2 correction already absorbs this; what it missed is error_ps, the entry below.

group_delay.error_ps.meaning: residual I/Q rail group-delay estimate error (the wideband w2 FIR absorbs the mismatch itself; this is what the dedicated estimator missed)
group_delay.error_ps.apply: delay the I rail by |error_ps| against Q (fractional delay). Attributing all of it to one rail is the worst-case reading of an unsigned residual.

rx_iq.irr_min_db.meaning: RX image rejection after the frequency-dependent correction, worst tone, at the calibrated AGC state
rx_iq.irr_min_db.apply: same widely-linear form as the TX entry, applied after the channel rather than before it.

dpd.evm_db.meaning: PA-output EVM after predistortion at the calibration drive level — the in-band distortion the amplifier still does, plus the transmit floor. This is the dominant in-band term; a residual list without it reads 10+ dB optimistic
dpd.evm_db.apply: add a complex Gaussian error at this level relative to signal power (the number is a per-tone-equalized measurement). Valid at the calibration drive; predistortion interacts with drive level, so re-derive before using it far from that operating point.

dpd.aclr_worst_dbc.meaning: worst adjacent-channel leakage ratio after DPD
dpd.aclr_worst_dbc.apply: a spectral figure — consumed by coexistence budgets, not by an in-band EVM replay.

agc_sweep.worst_landing_err_db.meaning: worst ADC landing-level error across the AGC ladder sweep
agc_sweep.worst_landing_err_db.apply: do not inject — verification of the servo; its effect is already inside every receive-side figure.

agc_sweep.min_snr_db_above_-50dBm.meaning: minimum post-chain SNR over inputs above -50 dBm during the AGC verification sweep
agc_sweep.min_snr_db_above_-50dBm.apply: do not inject — a verification aggregate over the sweep, not a single operating point.

final_loopback_evm.evm_db.meaning: composite TX+RX loopback EVM, shared LO (phase noise cancels in this view)
final_loopback_evm.evm_db.apply: never inject a total: re-applying it as a term makes any closure check pass by construction.

final_loopback_evm.tx_evm_db.meaning: PA-output EVM at the 802.11be TX measurement point (per-tone EQ + CPE removal) — the closure target the replay compares against
final_loopback_evm.tx_evm_db.apply: never inject — this is the measured whole the impairment entries are supposed to explain.

final_loopback_evm.rx_evm_db.meaning: ideal waveform through the impaired RX at the loopback's coupled level, independent LO (phase noise counts in full)
final_loopback_evm.rx_evm_db.apply: never inject — measured whole of the receive view.

final_loopback_evm.evm_modem_db.meaning: the loopback view read the way a standard receiver reads it: LTF CFO acquisition, LTF channel estimate smoothed over conditions.ce_smooth_tones tones and frozen for the packet, N_p-pilot CPE, data tones scored — evm_db plus the receiver's own estimation losses

final_loopback_evm.tx_evm_modem_db.meaning: PA-output EVM in the modem form (LTF acquisition + smoothed LTF channel estimate + pilot CPE) — the figure the MCS13 -38 dB spec verdict is taken on, since 0.7.18; tx_evm_db is the same capture in the isolation view and stays the replay's closure target because a receiver's estimation loss is not a residual of the chain
final_loopback_evm.tx_evm_modem_db.apply: never inject — a total; the difference to tx_evm_db is the receiver's estimator terms, 10 log(1 + rho/2) + 10 log(1 + 1/(2 N_p)) plus whatever the LTF estimate freezes of the residual image and distortion.

final_loopback_evm.rx_evm_modem_db.meaning: rx_evm_db in the modem form (same receiver chain as tx_evm_modem_db), independent LO
final_loopback_evm.rx_evm_modem_db.apply: never inject — measured whole of the receive view in the receiver's own reading.

final_loopback_evm.rx_input_dbm.meaning: the RF input level rx_evm_db (and the two figures below) were measured at — the level the loopback path actually delivers
final_loopback_evm.rx_input_dbm.better: n/a — an operating point, not a defect
final_loopback_evm.rx_input_dbm.apply: not injected itself; the noise recipe below converts through it. Receive figures far from this level need a re-measurement, not a scaling.

final_loopback_evm.rx_gain_state.meaning: the AGC gain state that level lands on — the receive figures are properties of this state, not of the die
final_loopback_evm.rx_gain_state.apply: not injected; it names which state the NF and phase figures describe.

final_loopback_evm.rx_nf_db.meaning: effective noise figure at that state, measured idle-channel through the whole chain (LNA to digital out) — absorbs thermal, quantization and correction residue, which is why it is the number to replay rather than the ladder's Friis entry
final_loopback_evm.rx_nf_db.apply: add complex AWGN at SNR = rx_input_dbm - (-174 + rx_nf_db + 10log10(BW)) dB relative to signal power.

final_loopback_evm.rx_phase_err_dbc.meaning: integrated post-tracking phase error at that state and level: what the angle costs after per-symbol common-phase and frequency tracking. Not pure LO phase noise — whatever the delivered state puts in the angle (residual per-state IQ, spurs) is included, deliberately
final_loopback_evm.rx_phase_err_dbc.apply: multiply by exp(j*phi), phi zero-mean Gaussian with variance 10^(dBc/10). The spectral shape is not shipped; a consumer needing the profile takes it from circuit data, not from this figure.

final_loopback_evm.rx_im3_dbc.meaning: two-tone third-order product at that state and total level, per tone, worst of 2f1-f2 / 2f2-f1 — the receive view's in-band distortion, the term whose absence the replay closure exposed
final_loopback_evm.rx_im3_dbc.apply: apply the memoryless cubic y + c*y*|y|^2 with c = 2 * 10^(rx_im3_dbc/20) on the unit-power COMPLEX-ENVELOPE waveform — that constant makes two equal tones at the same total power reproduce the measured ratio, and the OFDM statistics do the rest. State your simulator's convention: a real-passband cubic uses the classic 3/4 IM3 factor (c = 8/3 * 10^(dBc/20)) instead, and mixing the two overstates the term by 2.5 dB. Apply oversampled and band-limit after (out-of-band products alias in at 1x). Valid near rx_input_dbm; distortion scales 2 dB per dB of drive, so far from that level re-measure.
